entity_defs.title: Boolean
entity_defs.instructions: Use to represent boolean values in text.

entity_defs.name: Inferred Text
entity_defs.title: Inferred Text

label_groups.name: default

label_defs.name: Buyer Information
label_defs.instructions: Extract details about the buyer (recipient) of the invoice.

moon_form.name: Buyer Name
moon_form.instructions: Extract the full name of the buyer/recipient of the invoice.

moon_form.name: Buyer Address
moon_form.instructions: Extract the full address of the buyer, including street, city, postal code, and country.

moon_form.name: Buyer Country
moon_form.instructions: Extract the country of the buyer.

moon_form.name: Buyer Tax ID
moon_form.instructions: Extract the tax identification number of the buyer.

label_defs.name: Invoice Header
label_defs.instructions: Extract general invoice information such as invoice number, dates, purchase order number, and currency.

moon_form.name: Invoice Number
moon_form.instructions: Extract the unique invoice identification number.

moon_form.name: Invoice Date
moon_form.instructions: Extract the date the invoice was issued.

moon_form.name: Due Date
moon_form.instructions: Extract the date by which the invoice payment is due.

moon_form.name: Purchase Order Number
moon_form.instructions: Extract the purchase order number associated with this invoice.

moon_form.name: Currency
moon_form.instructions: Extract the currency used for all monetary values on the invoice (e.g., RON, AUD, USD, EUR).

label_defs.name: Invoice Totals
label_defs.instructions: Extract the summary of monetary amounts from the invoice.

moon_form.name: Subtotal
moon_form.instructions: Extract the subtotal amount before taxes and other charges. Include the currency.

moon_form.name: Tax Name
moon_form.instructions: Extract the name of the tax applied (e.g., VAT, GST).

moon_form.name: Tax Rate
moon_form.instructions: Extract the tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 19%, 10%).

moon_form.name: Tax Amount
moon_form.instructions: Extract the total tax amount. Include the currency.

moon_form.name: Total Amount
moon_form.instructions: Extract the grand total amount of the invoice, including all taxes and charges. Include the currency.

label_defs.name: Line Items
label_defs.instructions: Extract details for each individual line item listed on the invoice.

moon_form.name: Description
moon_form.instructions: Extract the description of the item.

moon_form.name: Quantity
moon_form.instructions: Extract the quantity of the item.

moon_form.name: Unit Price
moon_form.instructions: Extract the unit price of the item. Ensure to include the currency if specified in the column header.

moon_form.name: Line Total
moon_form.instructions: Extract the total amount for the individual line item. Ensure to include the currency if specified in the column header.

label_defs.name: Vendor Information
label_defs.instructions: Extract details about the vendor (sender) of the invoice.

moon_form.name: Vendor Name
moon_form.instructions: Extract the full name of the vendor/sender of the invoice.

moon_form.name: Vendor Address
moon_form.instructions: Extract the full address of the vendor, including street, city, postal code, and country.

moon_form.name: Vendor Country
moon_form.instructions: Extract the country of the vendor.

moon_form.name: Vendor Tax ID
moon_form.instructions: Extract the tax identification number of the vendor.

label_groups.instructions: Extract information from supplier invoices for two-way matching against purchase orders. This includes header details, vendor and buyer information, line items, and total amounts.
